messages.subject: App Share: Risk (the board game, not boring bank stuff)
parts:
I'm new to R and Shiny, but I'm really impressed with both of them.  Here's an app I've made to evaluate a potential attack in Risk.

https://gist.github.com/melondonkey/4734019

or direct link at 

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/melondonkey/riskApp/

I'm sure there's a ton of inefficiencies in the code, so if anyone has any ideas to improve, I'm open to constructive criticism, especially anything to make the simulation run faster.  

Also, thanks Joe Cheng for the responsiveness on the forum.
